# Restore artifact+manifest from verified rollback directory, then restart.
# Note: point.json is incomplete for lords-nova-canary rollback (no artifact_sha256/manifest_content).
python3 - <<'RESTORE'
from pathlib import Path
import json, os, tempfile
RB = Path("/srv/lords/.frontend/.rollback/20260919T194936Z-lords-01-deferred")
FRONT = Path("/srv/lords/.frontend")
artifact = (RB / "lords-frontend.py").read_bytes()
manifest = (RB / "template-manifest.json").read_bytes()
assert __import__("hashlib").sha256(artifact).hexdigest() == "06e991c3e558621c494e1150483b98eca67f2fcdc62ccaf0b165adf3e5b33432"
for target, data, mode in [
    (FRONT / "template-manifest.json", manifest, 0o644),
    (FRONT / "lords-frontend.py", artifact, 0o755),
]:
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=str(FRONT), prefix=".restore-")
    os.write(fd, data); os.close(fd)
    os.chmod(tmp, mode)
    os.replace(tmp, target)
print("restored", "06e991c3e558621c494e1150483b98eca67f2fcdc62ccaf0b165adf3e5b33432")
RESTORE
sudo -n systemctl restart lords-nova-01.service
